details: CORSAIR RM750e Fully Modular Low-Noise ATX Power Supply

RMe SERIES 
RM750e POWER SUPPLY
FULLY MODULAR LOW-NOISE ATX POWER SUPPLIES

STEADY POWER FOR YOUR SYSTEM
FULLY MODULAR CABLING 

Keep cable clutter down by connecting only the cables your system needs and nothing else. Five universal 8-pin connectors can be used with any 8-pin cable, satisfying all the power needs of modern motherboards and GPUs.
ON THE CUTTING-EDGE 
ATX 3.0 CERTIFIED 

The ATX 3.0 standard demands a high level of reliability and power efficiency. While many CORSAIR PSUs meet these requirements, RMe Series PSUs are formally certified for ATX 3.0 compliance. 

PCIe 5.0 12VHPWR GPU cable included for use with modern graphics cards such as the NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series.
LOW NOISE OPERATION IN A COMPACT SIZE 

Shorter than the traditional power supply, the RMe offers more cable space behind your PSU. 

Includes Zero RPM Fan Mode for near-silent operation at lower loads. 

LOW NOISE 
FAN MODE
TECHNOLOGY AND RELIABILITY 

For consistent, reliable power and superb electrical performance, each RMe Series power supply features a robust resonant LLC topology with DC-DC conversion and 105° rated industrial-grade capacitors. 

With precise timings, RMe supports Modern Standby, ensuring extremely fast wake-from-sleep times and better low-load efficiency.
80 PLUS GOLD-CERTIFIED 

Steady power output at up to 90% efficiency, and Cybenetics Platinum certified for lower power consumption, less noise, and cooler temperatures.
SEVEN-YEAR WARRANTY
WORLD-CLASS SUPPORT 

Our award-winning service means you can enjoy your gear worry-free.

products.title: Noctua NF-A14 PWM
products.name: Noctua NF-A14 PWM, Premium Quiet Fan, 4-Pin (140mm, Brown)
details: Noctua NF-A14 PWM, Premium Quiet Fan, 4-Pin (140mm, Brown)

The NF-A14 is a premium quality quiet 140mm fan with a square frame that complies with Noctua's AAO(Advanced Acoustic Optimisation) standard. Its square shape and 140mm mounting holes (124.5mm spacing) make it ideal for use on watercooling radiators or as an upgrade for 140mm case fans. Featuring sophisticated aerodynamic design measures such as Flow Acceleration Channels, the NF-A14 further improves the renowned quiet cooling performance of the award-winning NF-P14. The PWM version sports Noctua's custom designed NE-FD1 IC for fully automatic speed control via 4-pin fan headers and comes with a Low-Noise-Adaptor to reduce the maximum speed during PWM control from 1500rpm to 1200rpm. Its performance-oriented 1500rpm top speed and comprehensive speed control options make the NF-A14 PWM an elite choice for users who strive to strike a perfect balance between excellent cooling capacity and superb quietness of operation, be it on watercooling radiators, on heatsinks or in case ventilation.

products.title: CORSAIR AF120 ELITE High-Performance 120mm PWM
products.name: CORSAIR AF120 ELITE High-Performance 120mm PWM Fluid Dynamic Bearing Fan
details: CORSAIR AF120 ELITE High-Performance 120mm PWM Fluid Dynamic Bearing Fan

HIGH-PERFORMANCE COOLING

The ideal cooling fans for your PC provide optimal airflow to keep components cool at low to medium speeds. 

With up to 59.1CFM of airflow at peak 1,850 RPM, AF ELITE Series fans deliver the perfect balance between low noise, strong static pressure, and high airflow without compromising performance.

POWERFUL GUIDED AIRFLOW

CORSAIR AirGuide technology uses anti-vortex vanes to concentrate airflow, delivering improved cooling performance across your system’s components.

AS QUIET AS A WHISPER

Thanks to its low-noise design, the AF ELITE Series fan spins as quietly as 31.5 dba. 

Designed to support Zero RPM mode, AF ELITE fans eliminate fan noise by only spinning up when temperatures reach the threshold you’ve set using CORSAIR’s iCUE software.

EXCEPTIONAL DURABILITY

A fluid dynamic bearing reduces friction with lubricant between the shaft and bearing, ensuring exceptional durability and lifespan with minimal noise.

CORSAIR AirGuide Technology: Utilizes anti-vortex vanes to channel concentrated airflow and improve cooling, whether used as intake, exhaust, or mounted to a liquid cooling radiator or heatsink.

Fluid Dynamic Bearing: Lubricant between the shaft and bearing greatly reduces friction, ensuring exceptional durability and minimal noise.

Push Air Without Pushing the Decibels: A low-noise 120mm fan blade spins as quietly as 31.5 dBA.

Keep Your System Cool: Powerful PWM-controlled fan speeds from 400 RPM up to 1,850 RPM, pushing up to 59.1 CFM of air with 1.93mm-H2O of static pressure.

Zero RPM Mode Support: Stops the fan entirely when sent a 0 RPM PWM signal, completely eliminating fan noise.

Universal 120mm Sizing: Fits in case fan mounts, radiators, heatsinks, and more.
